events.title: FALL 2025 GAME JAM
events.subtitle: OCTOBER 17-19, 2025 | MAC 205
events.tagline: Join us for a weekend of collaborative prototyping, rapid pitching, and team building.
events.description: Spend the weekend building a fresh concept with artists, designers, writers, and programmers from across the club. We'll kick things off with theme reveals, mentoring check-ins, and a final showcase at the end of the jam.
events.imageAlt: Students gathered together during a Met Game Studios event

events.title: FALL 2025 CAREER PANEL
events.subtitle: OCTOBER 24, 2025 | MAC 205
events.tagline: Meet alumni and industry guests for practical advice on portfolios, internships, and creative careers.
events.description: A moderated conversation with alumni and guest speakers covering portfolio strategy, networking, and first-job expectations. Bring your questions and stick around afterward for an informal mixer.
events.imageAlt: Students listening during a community event

events.title: FALL 2025 SHOWCASE NIGHT
events.subtitle: DECEMBER 4, 2025 | RCC 204
events.tagline: A casual end-of-term spotlight on prototypes, updates, and the people behind them.
events.description: We'll close the term with short presentations, playable builds, and a community hangout. Expect snapshots from ongoing projects, team introductions, and a look ahead to the next semester.

events.title: WINTER 2026 CLUB KICKOFF
events.subtitle: JANUARY 15, 2026 | LIB 72
events.tagline: Start the semester with team intros, roadmap updates, and ways to plug into projects.
events.description: This kickoff session introduces the semester's initiatives, upcoming collaboration opportunities, and event calendar. New and returning members can meet leads, hear project pitches, and learn how to get involved right away.
events.imageAlt: Attendees speaking at a kickoff event

events.title: WINTER 2026 PLAYTEST LAB
events.subtitle: FEBRUARY 6, 2026 | POD 250
events.tagline: Bring your latest build, gather feedback fast, and trade notes with other teams.
events.description: An open-format playtest night focused on iteration. Teams can rotate through feedback stations, compare notes on usability and pacing, and leave with actionable next steps for their prototypes.
events.imageAlt: Students participating in a playtest session

events.title: WINTER 2026 GAME JAM
events.subtitle: FEBRUARY 12, 2026
events.tagline: Build something new with fellow developers, artists, designers, and storytellers during our winter jam.
events.description: The Winter 2026 Game Jam is a fast-paced club event focused on collaboration, creativity, and rapid prototyping. Form a team, explore an idea, and share your work with the community at the end of the jam.

events.title: WINTER 2026 STUDIO SOCIAL
events.subtitle: MARCH 12, 2026 | SLC 308
events.tagline: A low-pressure hangout for meeting collaborators, sharing works-in-progress, and celebrating milestones.
events.description: Part mixer, part mini-showcase, this social is designed to help people meet across disciplines. Drop in for conversation, community updates, and a few lighthearted activities between project sprints.
events.imageAlt: Students chatting at a social gathering
